title: DIO Main Chronicle — Original Source Manifest
collection_rule: Exact GitHub tree snapshot of all regular Git blobs reachable at the source commit; records each original path and unchanged Git blob ID. No files are moved, renamed, or rewritten. Git SHA-1 identities are not independently recomputed SHA-256. Does not assert exhaustive conversation transcript or coverage of unrelated branch-only files.
source_integrity: Original paths remain authoritative. Historical names are preserved exactly as found, including names that predate the user's current date-first naming standard.
project_scope: Full DIO source collection including PS5/CERBERUS; differentiate earlier DIO experiments from PS5 objective starting Nov 2, 2026.
migrate_strategy: Link/index only. A bulk Git object copy attempt was blocked by safety checks; no bulk mirror commit was made. Do not bypass safety controls.
